messages:
Ava (PM): Quick sync  we've got mixed asks: strict EU residency for some tenants, APAC latency class guarantees for others, and one customer wants a hybrid 'mixed residency' mode where metadata is EU-only but inference can run APAC. Need roadmap choices + pricing implications.
Priya (Arch): Mixed residency is interesting but tricky. We'd need attribute-level routing and stronger audit logs. Also compilers should expose compatibility across model builds per region.
Rafi (Eng): Implementation lanes: 1) policy templates + soft-affinity + dry-run (fast), 2) admission controller + reserved tranches (slow), 3) mixed residency = metadata-only residency flag + compute fallback rules (experimental).
Liam (SRE): Ops note: mixed mode expands failure surfaces. Must define clear fallback: metadata read-only vs full evacuation. Also require automated evacuation tests and a rollback script.
Marcos (Sales): Customers asked about pricing for mixed mode. Ben, can we sketch a premium for metadata-only residency vs full reservation?
Ben (Finance): Quick thought: metadata-only (low infra delta) -> small percent uplift; full reservation -> larger monthly tranche. Need capacity projection from simulator to finalize.
Zoe (Legal): Contracts must call out fallback sequences and what constitutes a breach. We can't promise "metadata never leaves EU" unless we control backups, logging, and KMS residency. For pilots, include explicit opt-ins and emergency cross-region clauses.
Ava (PM): Roadmap proposal: Q2 = templates + policy DSL + simulator + mixed-mode spike; Q3 = soft-affinity GA + pilot signups + telemetry; Q4 = reservation lanes + admission controller + pricing appendix.
Priya (Arch): Launch gates for mixed-mode spike: prototype audit trail, policy semantics documented, and telemetry that surfaces metadata-egress risk. For soft-affinity GA: percent_served_in_preferred_region >= 92% for pilot tenants.
Rafi (Eng): Policy proto sample: ```route_policy { tenant: "T-900" mode: "mixed|residency|latency" metadata_residency: "eu-west-1" prefer_region: "apac-1" reservation_mode: "soft" }``` Dry-run returns placement and egress-risk score.
Marcos (Sales): I'll line up pilot customers: one EU bank for residency, one APAC marketplace for latency, and a SaaS wanting mixed-mode. Will avoid hard promises until Q4.
Liam (SRE): Ops acceptance: 48h canary, chaos blackout validating fallback, automated rollback on >3 P0s or >15% cache-miss increase. Also require runbook and on-call rotation updates.
Ben (Finance): Need simulator numbers to model cost uplift scenarios (5/15/30% uplifts) and revenue levers (per-request surcharge, monthly tranche, or hybrid credits).
Zoe (Legal): Pilot contract checklist: fallback order, data-residency attestation steps, opt-in for emergency failover, and explicit non-guarantee for mixed-mode until we finish audits.
Ava (PM): Action items: Rafi  mixed-mode spike + dry-run API (2 sprints). Priya  policy semantics doc + telemetry spec (1 week). Liam  ops runbook + chaos plan (2 weeks). Marcos  pilot outreach + customer one-pager (1 week). Ben  pricing scenarios once simulator output available (1 week). Zoe  draft pilot T&Cs (3 days). ops-bot: Reminder: add roadmap PR to #release-war-room by EOD Fri. :bell:
Marcos (Sales): ack. I'll avoid using the term "no-egress" in sales collateral until Zoe signs off.
Rafi (Eng): I'll post the spike assumptions and a short spreadsheet with egress-risk scoring later today.
Priya (Arch): Also adding: policy-catalog presets: economy-global, latency-apac, residency-eu, mixed-meta. Makes sales conversations easier.
Ava (PM): Thanks team  next sync in 7 days to review spike results and decide Q2 commitments.
